summary: South Park entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: South Park: The Stick of Truth
entries.definitive_edition: Uncensored Windows PC release where available

primary.version: Uncensored PC release where regionally available
primary.why: The PC version is the best capture route and avoids the broader console-censorship issue in most regions, though PC censorship still applies in some territories. Archive the uncensored PC release where legally available and document region.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version through Steam/Ubisoft Connect in an uncensored region where available. Record storefront, region, censorship state, controller/keyboard setup, patch, and whether console-region censorship screens are being compared.

entries.title: South Park: The Fractured But Whole
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Gold/complete route with Season Pass DLC installed where owned

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC build with owned DLC at documented settings

primary.version: Gold/complete PC route with Season Pass DLC where owned
primary.why: The PC route is the best capture path for the sequel and can include Season Pass story DLC in one archive pass. Console and Switch routes are useful comparison targets, but PC has the strongest settings/capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC release through Steam/Ubisoft Connect with owned DLC installed. Record build, storefront, Ubisoft Connect state, DLC ownership, difficulty, class/build, controller/input, region/language, and whether Switch/console ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for platform comparison or portability documentation.
secondary.why: PC remains the best capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront, Ubisoft Connect, and DLC ownership state explicitly.
